content.content:
527	### D.3 Soft pool scale
528	
529	The `soft_pool_scale` formula is defined as:
530	
531	`r_lit = max(r_lit_px, 0)` and `r_off = max(r_off_px, 0)`, where `r_lit_px` / `r_off_px` are the largest `d` in `0..R` whose integer chain `c(d) = ⌊output_pm × ⌊1000 × (R − d) / R⌋ / 1000⌋` gives `c(d) ≥ LIT_ON_PM` / `c(d) ≥ LIT_OFF_PM` (−1 when `c(0) = output_pm` is below the threshold; `EM D.7`; the closed form `⌊R × (output_pm − threshold) / output_pm⌋` is retired); `r_draw = max(r_off, POOL_RESIDUAL_PX)`; `band_px = r_off − r_lit`; `texture_scale = r_draw / edge_radius_texels` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review; re-review)*
532	
533	**Variables:**
534	
535	| Variable | Type | Range | Source | Description |
536	|---|---|---|---|---|
537	| `r_lit_px` | int | −1..`R` | read view (EM AC-46b, EM D.7) | the published actionable radius of the integer chain at `LIT_ON_PM`; −1 is a sentinel that Lighting maps to `r_lit` 0, never to a negative scale or band *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* |
538	| `r_off_px` | int | −1..`R` | asked of Emitter State (Ask E-K); interim: Lighting runs the identical chain at `LIT_OFF_PM` | the latch-release radius of the same chain; −1 maps to 0 *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* |
539	| `R` | int | 72 (fault glow default) / 96 / 120 / 144 | `light_shape` rows 10 / 6, 9 / 5 / 7; the glowstick's `reach_px` follows `EM D.9` | the simulation's fade-out radius |
540	| `output_pm`, `LIT_ON_PM`, `LIT_OFF_PM` | int | 0..1000, 150 (locked), 120 (locked) | read view; REG `LIT_ON_PM`, `LIT_OFF_PM` (the latch of `EM D.8`, EM-22) | served brightness, the lit-on threshold and the latch-release threshold *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* |
541	| `POOL_RESIDUAL_PX` | int | 0..16; placeholder 8 | ★ Tuning Knobs | drawn size of a starved light's pool |
542	| `edge_radius_texels` | float | `light_fixture` 1024²: 512; `light_pool` 512²: 256 (nominal) | sidecar | texel radius of the pool disc |
543	
544	**Output Range:** `r_draw` ≥ `r_off` ≥ `r_lit` always, so a prompt can never appear outside the visible pool: a subject already lit keeps its prompt to `r_off` (the drawn edge), and an approaching subject meets its prompt at `r_lit`, `band_px` inside the edge; fixture 8..126 px. The profile is the simulation's own curve truncated at `r_off` (LO-7), so a step of `LIT_OFF_PM / output_pm` of the apex remains at the edge. *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* **Example (fixture, R 144, `light_fixture` `edge_radius_texels` 512):**
545	
546	| `output_pm` | 1000 | 600 | 300 | 200 | 160 | 150 | 140 | 121 | 120 |
547	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
548	| `r_lit_px` (published; −1 is the sentinel) | 122 | 108 | 72 | 36 | 8 | 0 | −1 | −1 | −1 |
549	| `r_lit` = max(`r_lit_px`, 0) (prompt on approach) | 122 | 108 | 72 | 36 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
550	| `r_off` (prompt kept when already lit) | 126 | 115 | 86 | 57 | 36 | 28 | 20 | 1 | 0 |
551	| `r_draw` (the drawn edge) | 126 | 115 | 86 | 57 | 36 | 28 | 20 | 8 | 8 |
552	| `band_px` | 4 | 7 | 14 | 21 | 28 | 28 | 20 | 1 | 0 |
553	| `texture_scale` | 0.2461 | 0.2246 | 0.1680 | 0.1113 | 0.0703 | 0.0547 | 0.0391 | 0.0156 | 0.0156 |
554	| drawn energy (D.1) | 1.000 | 0.600 | 0.300 | 0.200 | 0.160 | 0.150 | 0.140 | 0.121 | 0.120 |
555	
556	At output 140 the pool is 20 px wide (it was 8 px under the earlier `r_lit` rule while the prompt persisted to 20 px) and at 121 the pool is the 8 px residual while the prompt persists 1 px. Glowstick: steady `reach_px` 96 gives `r_lit` 81 and `r_off` 84; at its last wane step `reach_px` 24 the chain gives `r_lit` 20 and `r_off` 21 (not a closed form), scale 21 / 256 = 0.0820. The 160 column is the case that separated the closed form from the chain: `R` 144 at 160 permille gives `r_lit_px` 8 (the closed form gave 9) and band 28 (it gave 27). *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* Baked rim: `FIXED` mode bakes 0.12 of the apex; at 600 permille the simulation's illumination at `r_off` is 120 permille absolute and the drawn rim 72 (0.12 × 600), at the correct radius (ESTIMATE; spike step 2 compares `FAMILY17`).
